Create and validate the versioned operational basis, compare complete producer groups, reset stale review, and include the sidecar in the receipt output boundary.
Resolve connector inputs from the active immutable profile snapshot on every supported connector route.
Own canonical sidecar DDL and fail-closed exact physical signature validation.
Use shared table schema and clear sidecar with registry, audit, and alignment rows on canonical graph rebuild.
Carry one effective profile snapshot through pipeline stages and actual consumers.
Recompute core output receipt/currentness over the source inventory, including the sidecar.
Copy registered source profiles under the registry state lock without changing existing get/list_all identity behavior.
Exercise actual DuckDB sidecar schema, content binding, malformed digest and schema refusals, public DatasetMatch evidence, graph cleanup, and catalog/legacy transaction rollback.
Exercise all supported connector routes against coherent profile override and execution-policy snapshots.
Exercise run identity and pipeline consumer behavior under supported profile overrides.
Exercise header-only profile change, receipt currentness, and same-snapshot runtime resolution.
Prove copied snapshots survive a supported registry override.
Exercise real producer-to-observation/benchmark replay; verify sidecar recomputation, rejection of forged digest, and receipt invalidation/recovery.
Prove operational sidecar mutations leave the selected-catalog credal reference hash unchanged.

profile_and_backend.backend: Real temporary DuckDB databases and canonical DuckDB metadata/schema reads in pytest fixtures; connector calls use deterministic fixture responses. No production database/profile/input was read or modified.
profile_and_backend.profile_snapshot: SourceProfileRegistry.snapshot_all() deep-copies under the registry lock; a single scoped runtime snapshot binds source profile payload/coverage, connection configuration, execution policy, UNPD token presence/value in memory, and legacy serial setting across config identity, pipeline/direct ingest, receipt/currentness/resume and connector resolution.
profile_and_backend.secret_handling: Header/auth values and environment token are not persisted, hashed into stored fields, or logged; excluded-input presence is typed, and unknown coverage is not reusable.

implemented_chain.input_and_producer: A copied effective profile/material snapshot and complete CatalogTransportDataset producer payload bind catalog source/profile currentness and the complete competing VariableAlignment model group.
implemented_chain.artifact: Versioned ds_alignment_review_basis sidecar keyed by dataset_id and raw_variable, with canonical payload and recomputed digest; the existing producer evidence string is unchanged.
implemented_chain.bridge_and_lifecycle: Catalog and legacy ingestion transact registry datasets, audit rows, alignment rows, and sidecar replacement together. Receipt outputs include the sidecar. Canonical graph rebuild clears sidecar and related catalog rows together.
implemented_chain.consumer_and_surface: DatasetRegistry.find_datasets_for_variable returns actual DatasetMatch values with unchanged alignment_evidence. The selected-catalog credal reference hash remains invariant under sidecar-only changes. Core-source receipt/currentness gates benchmark reuse and fresh producer replay.
semantic_positive_and_negatives: Unchanged basis preserves existing audit annotations and receipt/currentness across actual producer replay.

Changed same-size/same-mtime material bytes or a supported profile override changes identity, invalidates stale receipt/review reuse, reruns core producer and benchmark, and a fresh benchmark can be skipped only after a current receipt exists.
Missing, malformed, forged, unbound legacy, or changed sidecar basis clears prior review; independent removal replay confirms missing-basis reset then restores the candidate basis.
Injected failures after actual alignment writes roll back all four catalog/audit/alignment/basis relations for both catalog and legacy paths.
Sidecar-only mutation leaves public DatasetMatch.alignment_evidence and selected-catalog credal reference hash unchanged.
Direct in-place mutation of a compatibility-preserved mutable live profile remains a reproduced bounded residual, not a pass.
